kind: Isolated CMake generator-expression branch probe; no MSVC or full renderer build
probe_source:
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.18)
project(viewer_flags_probe LANGUAGES CXX)
# This is a generator-expression branch probe, not an MSVC compiler run.
# The C++ compiler really remains GCC; only the ID for expression evaluation
# is selected here. Do not compile the generated MSVC-probe build files.
set(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID "${PROBE_COMPILER_ID}")
add_subdirectory("${RENDERER_SOURCE_DIR}/viewer" viewer)
file(GENERATE OUTPUT "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/viewer-options.txt"
    CONTENT "$<TARGET_GENEX_EVAL:viewer,$<TARGET_PROPERTY:viewer,COMPILE_OPTIONS>>\n")
